title: PHP Beginner Mock Test 2
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for PHP at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of strict types?

options.text: declare it in typed application source
strict_types limits scalar coercion for calls from the declaring file
it does not validate HTTP input automatically
PHP automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: declare it in typed application source. Confirm with linting, focused tests, and observable failure handling.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of linting?

options.text: lint before tests and deployment
php lint checks syntax without executing application behavior
syntax success does not prove runtime correctness
PHP automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: lint before tests and deployment. Confirm with linting, focused tests, and observable failure handling.

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of Composer?

questions.prompt: Which is the safest beginner application of strict comparison?
